The '''legendary vortex rifle''' was a weapon of unknown origin and steeped in mystery. According to legend, this weapon was supposedly used by various heroes, centuries prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Although very old, the weapon was in perfect condition, as if [[Time/Legends|time]] had no effect on it. It was as powerful as the many models of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] found during the Civil War.

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Legendary vortex rifle appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TLVR" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Legendary vortex rifle was added to the game with the release of the the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 3|Chapter 3]]," on [[September 27]], [[2006]].<ref name="CA2006">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64186&resource=publish|text=Chapter Archive 2006}}</ref> The weapon could be purchased from a [[Recruitment officer/Legends|faction recruiter]] by players who had achieved the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[General/Legends|general]].<ref name="SWG:TLVR" />
